title: Catalog filters
responsibility: Opens catalog filters and sorting from one compact icon.

inputs.name: FilterDialog.active
inputs.description: Number of active choices supplied by the caller, defaulting to 0; the component does not count them itself. The icon is highlighted only when the value is greater than 0, and its title shows 'Filters · N active' for any truthy value, including negative numbers.

inputs.name: FilterDialog.onreset
inputs.description: Passed directly as the Reset filters button's onclick handler, so it runs on every click and receives the click event as its first argument, although its type is () => void. The component does not close the dialog when it runs, and what the callback restores is up to the caller.

inputs.name: FilterDialog.children
inputs.description: Content snippet rendered with @render inside the hx-div.filter-fields wrapper that forms the main content of the Filters modal. The component renders it as passed and adds no controls of its own to that main content.

outputs.name: FilterDialog
outputs.description: Clicking the icon button labeled Filters opens a Modal titled Filters with the children as its main content and Reset filters and Done buttons in its footer; Done is the one filled primary button (class primary) and Reset filters a transparent secondary. Done and the Modal's onClose both call close, which closes the modal and then, after tick(), focuses the icon; Reset calls onreset.
